checks.statement: Use chips for contextual options that help with the current task; group multiple chips together rather than displaying a single chip alone.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Chips guidance.

evidence.result: The preview presents one chip at a time with generic labels and no task/product context for judging contextual relevance.

implementation.notes: The preview presents one chip at a time with generic labels and no task/product context for judging contextual relevance.

checks.statement: Use chips for contextual supplemental choices, not major actions that finish or advance a task; use buttons for those persistent progression actions.
checks.condition: When choosing between chips and buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Chips aren’t buttons guidance.

evidence.result: The isolated chip has no primary task flow or progression action to compare against a button.

implementation.notes: The isolated chip has no primary task flow or progression action to compare against a button.

checks.statement: Choose assist for contextual actions, filter for filtering results, suggestion for product-generated content, and input for user-entered content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Variants guidance.

evidence.result: Renderer exposes separate assist, filter, suggestion and input markup/configuration paths with variant-specific sample labels.

implementation.notes: Renderer exposes separate assist, filter, suggestion and input markup/configuration paths with variant-specific sample labels.

checks.statement: Use an outline on ordinary backgrounds; elevation may separate chips from images or dynamic backgrounds, but do not use elevation to show a pressed state.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container guidance.

evidence.result: Chip styles map elevation/container separately from pressed state; case attributes select elevated independently.

implementation.notes: Chip styles map elevation/container separately from pressed state; case attributes select elevated independently.

checks.statement: Keep chip labels to 20 characters or fewer.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Label text guidance.

evidence.result: All fixed sample labels are at most 13 characters, under the 20-character limit.

implementation.notes: All fixed sample labels are at most 13 characters, under the 20-character limit.

checks.statement: Provide a trailing remove icon on input chips because it is required to remove the chip.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Trailing icon (optional, input and filter chips only) guidance.
Split the original combined record into separate input-chip, filter-chip, and secondary-target requirements; this check now covers the required input-chip removal affordance.

evidence.result: Input chips always render a trailing remove control; removable filter chips render it conditionally. The control is separate but no minimum 48dp action hit area is declared here.

implementation.notes: Input chips always render a trailing remove control; removable filter chips render it conditionally. The control is separate but no minimum 48dp action hit area is declared here.

checks.statement: Write assist chips like buttons with a short leading verb, update labels as state changes, and show them after primary content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Assist chips guidance.

evidence.result: Assist sample text is “Assist chip” rather than a leading-verb action; no dynamic state label or placement after primary content is modeled.

implementation.notes: Assist sample text is “Assist chip” rather than a leading-verb action; no dynamic state label or placement after primary content is modeled.

checks.statement: Label filter chips with categories to include, not negative phrases; a set may be single- or multi-select, but do not mix the two behaviors on a page.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filter chips guidance.

evidence.result: Filter label is generic and selected state is available; the preview does not represent a category inclusion/exclusion set or enforce consistent page selection mode.

implementation.notes: Filter label is generic and selected state is available; the preview does not represent a category inclusion/exclusion set or enforce consistent page selection mode.

checks.statement: Provide a secondary cue that chips are interactive, such as a group prompt, interactive page context, a 3:1 outline, or an interactive label/leading icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Showing chip interactivity guidance.

evidence.result: Native action buttons and focus outlines convey interactivity, but no prompt/group context or computed 3:1 outline contrast is established.

implementation.notes: Native action buttons and focus outlines convey interactivity, but no prompt/group context or computed 3:1 outline contrast is established.

checks.statement: Show the remove icon when a chip can be removed, except on mobile when removal is its only action; each chip is focusable, with separate focus targets when selection and removal are separate actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Input chip remove action guidance.

evidence.result: Input chip has separate selection and remove controls; removal becomes keyboard reachable when selected/focused and primary/remove focus is managed.

implementation.notes: Input chip has separate selection and remove controls; removal becomes keyboard reachable when selected/focused and primary/remove focus is managed.

checks.statement: Use chips to help people complete their current task more easily.
checks.condition: When choosing whether to use chips.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: Generic standalone preview has no current task context to evaluate usefulness.

implementation.notes: Generic standalone preview has no current task context to evaluate usefulness.

checks.statement: Present chips together as an interactive set; do not display a single chip alone.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Chips aren’t buttons instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen intentionally previews one instance; it does not create a product chip set.

implementation.notes: The specimen intentionally previews one instance; it does not create a product chip set.

checks.statement: Use chips for contextual supplemental options and buttons for actions that progress or finish a task; keep a button arrangement to no more than three buttons.
checks.condition: When selecting between chips and buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Chips aren’t buttons instructions.

evidence.result: No page action flow or button arrangement is represented by one chip specimen.

implementation.notes: No page action flow or button arrangement is represented by one chip specimen.

checks.statement: Use an 8dp corner radius and an outline on ordinary backgrounds; elevation may separate chips from images or dynamic backgrounds, but do not use elevation for pressed feedback.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: Shape, outline, and elevation are token-backed; the specified 8dp radius and when-to-elevate rule depend on resolved values and host background.

implementation.notes: Shape, outline, and elevation are token-backed; the specified 8dp radius and when-to-elevate rule depend on resolved values and host background.

checks.statement: Use the same typography style as buttons and keep labels brief, omitting conventional grammar when needed to fit the short label.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Label text instructions.

evidence.result: Chip label receives token-backed component font family, size, line-height, tracking, and weight.

implementation.notes: Chip label receives token-backed component font family, size, line-height, tracking, and weight.

checks.statement: Use a system icon to identify a chip category; unselected icon color may use primary by default or on-surface-variant for less emphasis.
checks.condition: When a chip has a leading icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Leading icon or image (optional) instructions.

evidence.result: Category icons are provided as check/star SVGs and use tokenized icon color; primary vs on-surface-variant role depends on variant/state resolution.

implementation.notes: Category icons are provided as check/star SVGs and use tokenized icon color; primary vs on-surface-variant role depends on variant/state resolution.

checks.statement: Make a leading circular image larger than a leading icon or logo so it can show more detail; keep icons legible at small sizes.
checks.condition: When a chip has a leading image or icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Leading icon or image (optional) instructions.

evidence.result: The preview uses an initial avatar letter and vector icons, not a leading image asset whose larger circular size can be judged.

implementation.notes: The preview uses an initial avatar letter and vector icons, not a leading image asset whose larger circular size can be judged.

checks.statement: A filter chip may use a trailing icon to remove the filter or open a menu.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Trailing icon (optional, input and filter chips only) instructions.

evidence.result: Removable filter configuration includes a trailing close control; a menu action is not part of this preview.

implementation.notes: Removable filter configuration includes a trailing close control; a menu action is not part of this preview.

checks.statement: Keep a trailing secondary action at least 48×48dp without interfering with the chip’s primary action; use at least 88dp chip width or 42dp label width as needed.
checks.condition: When a chip has a separate trailing action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Trailing icon (optional, input and filter chips only) instructions.

evidence.result: The remove button is an independent secondary action, but no 48dp minimum hit area or 88dp chip/42dp label minimum is implemented in the inspected styles.

implementation.notes: The remove button is an independent secondary action, but no 48dp minimum hit area or 88dp chip/42dp label minimum is implemented in the inspected styles.

checks.statement: Assist chips may open a modal, full-screen content, or inline results; provide progress or confirmation feedback when the action needs it.
checks.condition: When an assist-chip action changes or takes time.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Assist chips instructions.

evidence.result: Assist chip emits a semantic action event, but no modal/full-screen/inline result or progress/confirmation feedback is bound by this generic specimen.

implementation.notes: Assist chip emits a semantic action event, but no modal/full-screen/inline result or progress/confirmation feedback is bound by this generic specimen.

checks.statement: Selecting a filter chip adds a leading checkmark; filter chips may be single-select or multi-select, but all chip sets on a page must use the same selection mode.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filter chips instructions.

evidence.result: Filter chip includes a leading check icon and selected-state styling; single/multi set mode is left to its containing page.

implementation.notes: Filter chip includes a leading check icon and selected-state styling; single/multi set mode is left to its containing page.

checks.statement: At medium and expanded breakpoints, a filter-chip trailing action may remove a filter or open its menu; at compact sizes, make the whole chip open the menu if the trailing target is too small.
checks.condition: For filter chips with trailing actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filter chips instructions.

evidence.result: Removable filter action remains a trailing button at all widths; no breakpoint makes the whole compact chip open a menu.

implementation.notes: Removable filter action remains a trailing button at all widths; no breakpoint makes the whole compact chip open a menu.

checks.statement: Do not present only one filter-chip option; for more than two wrapped rows, consider horizontal scrolling, and use a side sheet to organize many filters.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filter chips instructions.

evidence.result: Single preview does not render a set of filter options or wrapped rows to assess count/organization.

implementation.notes: Single preview does not render a set of filter options or wrapped rows to assess count/organization.

checks.statement: Allow input chips to return to editable text when editing; pressing Backspace with the cursor before a chip selects it, and pressing Backspace again deletes it.
checks.condition: When input chips can be edited or removed from a text field.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Input chips instructions.

evidence.result: Chip keyboard handler supports arrow movement and removal with Backspace/Delete, but has no editable text/cursor-before-chip select-then-delete behavior.

implementation.notes: Chip keyboard handler supports arrow movement and removal with Backspace/Delete, but has no editable text/cursor-before-chip select-then-delete behavior.

checks.statement: Allow input chips to be reordered or moved between fields; they may expand through a container-transform transition to reveal more options or information.
checks.condition: When input chips support reordering, moving, or expansion.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Input chips instructions.

evidence.result: The input-chip specimen supports selection and removal only; no reorder/move-between-fields or container-transform expansion is implemented.

implementation.notes: The input-chip specimen supports selection and removal only; no reorder/move-between-fields or container-transform expansion is implemented.

checks.statement: Place input chips inline with a text-field cursor, in a stacked list, or in a horizontally scrollable list; they may wrap when all chips need to remain visible.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Placement instructions.

evidence.result: This isolated chip is not placed within a text field or multi-chip collection, so wrapping/stacked/scroll placement is not exercised.

implementation.notes: This isolated chip is not placed within a text field or multi-chip collection, so wrapping/stacked/scroll placement is not exercised.

checks.statement: Align the input-chip trailing icon to the container’s ending edge (right in LTR and left in RTL); overflowed text-field chips should behave like regular text, showing the beginning unfocused and moving the cursor to the end when focused.
checks.condition: For input chips in text fields.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Icons & images instructions.

evidence.result: Trailing icon is a logical trailing action and CSS adjusts inline-end padding; RTL direction is inherited by inline flex layout.

implementation.notes: Trailing icon is a logical trailing action and CSS adjusts inline-end padding; RTL direction is inherited by inline flex layout.

checks.statement: Write suggestion-chip labels as context-appropriate nouns or short phrases and keep them to 20 characters or fewer when possible.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Suggestion chips instructions.

evidence.result: Suggestion sample is “Suggestion chip”, a short context-neutral noun phrase under 20 characters.

implementation.notes: Suggestion sample is “Suggestion chip”, a short context-neutral noun phrase under 20 characters.

checks.statement: Arrange multiple chips inline as a row, wrap overflowing chips to a new row or horizontally scroll a one-row field, maintain 8dp between chips, and provide 48dp minimum targets regardless of density.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Placement instructions.

evidence.result: Chip has flex layout, tokenized gaps and min-height, but no chip-set wrapper implementing wrapping/scrolling or 48dp target for the group.

implementation.notes: Chip has flex layout, tokenized gaps and min-height, but no chip-set wrapper implementing wrapping/scrolling or 48dp target for the group.

checks.statement: Keep chip labels concise; wrapped layouts may truncate labels when they exceed the available width.
checks.condition: When chip sets wrap or the viewport is narrow.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Placement instructions.

evidence.result: Chip labels can wrap anywhere and chip is max-width 100%, but no >20-character truncation/ellipsis rule is present.

implementation.notes: Chip labels can wrap anywhere and chip is max-width 100%, but no >20-character truncation/ellipsis rule is present.

checks.statement: Allow assistive technology users to perform actions on chips, navigate to them, and activate them.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Assist/suggestion controls are native buttons; selectable and removable variants expose separate button controls and dispatch action/remove events.

implementation.notes: Assist/suggestion controls are native buttons; selectable and removable variants expose separate button controls and dispatch action/remove events.

checks.statement: Maintain at least 3:1 contrast between the chip label and background; expose action chips with button semantics through the platform accessibility API.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Interaction & style instructions.

evidence.result: Label/container colors are tokenized and actions use native buttons, but 3:1 contrast is not computed; Web source guidance may expect gridcell roles unlike current button/span markup.

implementation.notes: Label/container colors are tokenized and actions use native buttons, but 3:1 contrast is not computed; Web source guidance may expect gridcell roles unlike current button/span markup.

checks.statement: When a row has too many chips, offer a Show all filter chip that expands the list and shifts following content down.
checks.condition: When chip rows overflow and reflow is appropriate.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Horizontal overflow instructions.

evidence.result: No chip-set overflow, Show all item, or following-content shift behavior is implemented.

implementation.notes: No chip-set overflow, Show all item, or following-content shift behavior is implemented.

checks.statement: Alternatively, offer a leading button to show all chip options in a menu without moving following content; do not use this menu method for chips with a second action such as removal.
checks.condition: When chip rows overflow and content position should remain fixed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Horizontal overflow instructions.

evidence.result: The single chip specimen has no overflowing chip set or leading Show all control.

implementation.notes: The single chip specimen has no overflowing chip set or leading Show all control.

checks.statement: Do not apply density by default; when a higher-density option is available, keep its controls at least 48×48 CSS pixels so density can be reversed accessibly.
checks.condition: For chip layouts with density options.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Avoid applying density by default instructions.

evidence.result: The chip preview has no density customization control.

implementation.notes: The chip preview has no density customization control.

checks.statement: Use the chip’s visible label as its accessibility label and label additional actions such as removal separately.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements instructions.

evidence.result: Visible chip label supplies the primary control name; remove button has a separate “Remove {chip label}” aria-label.

implementation.notes: Visible chip label supplies the primary control name; remove button has a separate “Remove {chip label}” aria-label.

checks.statement: In multi-select sets, Space or Enter selects or deselects the focused chip; allow only one chip to hold focus at a time.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Multi-select instructions.

evidence.result: Each filter chip exposes a native selection button and Space/Enter activation; no one-tab-stop roving focus or chip-set keyboard controller exists.

implementation.notes: Each filter chip exposes a native selection button and Space/Enter activation; no one-tab-stop roving focus or chip-set keyboard controller exists.

checks.statement: Match each dropdown list item’s accessibility label to its text; mark a redundant icon decorative when the text already conveys its meaning.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Drop-down list instructions.

evidence.result: No chip dropdown list is rendered.

implementation.notes: No chip dropdown list is rendered.

checks.statement: On mobile, when removal is the only chip action, removal may use selection plus Delete without a remove icon; make each chip focusable, combining focus for a remove-only chip and separating focus for chip content and removal when it has a second action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Input chip remove action instructions.

evidence.result: Remove-only/mobile combined focus mode is absent; two-action chips use separate controls and arrow movement, but the current template sets the remove button tabindex=-1 until focus management changes.

implementation.notes: Remove-only/mobile combined focus mode is absent; two-action chips use separate controls and arrow movement, but the current template sets the remove button tabindex=-1 until focus management changes.

checks.statement: Tab moves focus to an enabled chip or chip group.
checks.condition: When navigating a chip set by keyboard.
checks.notes: Preserves the Tab row in the captured chip keyboard table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the Tab row in the captured chip keyboard table.

evidence.result: Action chips are native buttons and therefore tab reachable; the set/group has no roving entry controller and enabled-chip/group navigation cannot be verified in this single-chip preview.

implementation.notes: Action chips are native buttons and therefore tab reachable; the set/group has no roving entry controller and enabled-chip/group navigation cannot be verified in this single-chip preview.

checks.statement: Arrow keys move focus between chips.
checks.condition: When navigating a chip set by keyboard.
checks.notes: Preserves the arrow-key row in the captured chip keyboard table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the arrow-key row in the captured chip keyboard table.

evidence.result: For chips with separate selection/removal actions, logical arrow direction moves focus between the two controls; no group-to-group traversal is present.

implementation.notes: For chips with separate selection/removal actions, logical arrow direction moves focus between the two controls; no group-to-group traversal is present.

checks.statement: Space or Enter activates, selects, or deselects the focused chip.
checks.condition: When a chip has keyboard focus.
checks.notes: Preserves the activation and selection outcomes in the captured table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the activation and selection outcomes in the captured table.

evidence.result: Chip actions use native buttons; click handler toggles filter selection and dispatches assist/suggestion action events.

implementation.notes: Chip actions use native buttons; click handler toggles filter selection and dispatches assist/suggestion action events.

checks.statement: Backspace or Delete removes the currently focused input chip.
checks.condition: When an input chip has keyboard focus and is removable.
checks.notes: Preserves both removal keys and the focused input-chip condition from the table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves both removal keys and the focused input-chip condition from the table.

evidence.result: Backspace/Delete on a focused input chip calls its remove button and hides the chip.

implementation.notes: Backspace/Delete on a focused input chip calls its remove button and hides the chip.

checks.statement: Hide an image or icon within a chip from accessibility announcements.
checks.condition: When an image/icon is decorative within the chip.
checks.notes: The chip accessibility table assigns “Hide image” to images/icons within a chip.

sourceHistory.summary: The chip accessibility table assigns “Hide image” to images/icons within a chip.

evidence.result: Leading avatar and icon spans are visual affordances; they are not assigned accessible names and share the control’s text label.

implementation.notes: Leading avatar and icon spans are visual affordances; they are not assigned accessible names and share the control’s text label.

checks.statement: Label a basic one-action chip as “{chip content}”; expose it as a gridcell on Web and a button in Android Views and Jetpack Compose.
checks.condition: For a basic chip with one action.
checks.notes: Preserves the basic-chip table row and its Web, Android Views, and Jetpack Compose role mapping.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the basic-chip table row and its Web, Android Views, and Jetpack Compose role mapping.

evidence.result: One-action assist/suggestion chips are native buttons on Web, while the captured platform table requires gridcell for Web; no platform-specific role wrapper is present.

implementation.notes: One-action assist/suggestion chips are native buttons on Web, while the captured platform table requires gridcell for Web; no platform-specific role wrapper is present.

checks.statement: Label a selectable chip as “{chip content}”; expose it as a gridcell on Web, a radio button in Android Views, and a checkbox in Jetpack Compose.
checks.notes: Preserves the selectable-chip table row, including platform-specific role differences.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the selectable-chip table row, including platform-specific role differences.

evidence.result: Selectable chip is an inner native button with aria-pressed inside a span; Web table requires gridcell and Android Views/Compose roles are not implemented in this web path.

implementation.notes: Selectable chip is an inner native button with aria-pressed inside a span; Web table requires gridcell and Android Views/Compose roles are not implemented in this web path.

checks.statement: Label a remove-only chip action “Remove {chip content}”; the table assigns no separate role for this row.
checks.condition: For a chip whose only action is removal.
checks.notes: Preserves the remove-only label and the role cells marked with dashes.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the remove-only label and the role cells marked with dashes.

evidence.result: Remove action uses the exact accessible label pattern “Remove ” plus the visible chip content; source table assigns no separate role for this row.

implementation.notes: Remove action uses the exact accessible label pattern “Remove ” plus the visible chip content; source table assigns no separate role for this row.

checks.statement: For a chip with selection and removal actions, announce “{chip content}” followed by “Remove {chip content}”; expose the actions as button or checkbox roles in Web, Android Views, and Jetpack Compose.
checks.condition: For a chip that supports both selection and removal.
checks.notes: Preserves the separate content/action labels and the button-or-checkbox role options across all three platform columns.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the separate content/action labels and the button-or-checkbox role options across all three platform columns.

evidence.result: Select and remove controls are both native buttons on Web; the captured platform matrix requires the distinct Web/Android Views/Compose button or checkbox roles, not represented by a platform-specific role mapping.

implementation.notes: Select and remove controls are both native buttons on Web; the captured platform matrix requires the distinct Web/Android Views/Compose button or checkbox roles, not represented by a platform-specific role mapping.
